evidence.detail: rs/s/r/b owns only reviewed TileIndicatorConfig rs/s/r/a; the reviewed TileIndicatorsPlugin rs/s/r/c is the runtime plugin for the same package and exact 'Tile Indicators' feature.

When the destination-tile setting is enabled, the overlay reads the client's destination coordinates, converts them to a local tile and draws that tile using the configured destination highlight/fill colors and border width.
When the hovered-tile setting is enabled, the overlay reads the client's hovered tile coordinates and renders the corresponding tile using the hovered-tile config colors and shared border width.

When the current-tile setting is enabled, the overlay resolves the local Player's current WorldPoint/local tile and renders it using the configured current-tile highlight/fill colors and border width.

proposals.note: TileIndicatorsOverlay is fixed by exclusive TileIndicatorConfig ownership and a complete three-surface current/destination/hovered tile render path. Confidence is 0.999.
